fields.title: Business name search result
fields.description: One record per matching business name for a query (or a single _error/no_results record when a query has no matches or fails validation/transport). Raw passthrough from ORC's public Name Search tool -- name and entity type only; the registry does not expose registration numbers, status, address, or directors through this public search.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query string that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-name-search, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed/empty queries (no_results, invalid_query, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error (for invalid_query, this is ORC's own validation message).

searchType.title: Search type
searchType.description: eq (exact) / sw (starts with) / ew (ends with) / cn (contains) -- as sent for this query.

_totalAvailable.title: Total available matches
_totalAvailable.description: Total matching business names ORC reported for this query, before any maxResultsPerQuery truncation.

_truncated.title: Truncated
_truncated.description: True if _totalAvailable exceeded maxResultsPerQuery and not every match was pushed to the dataset.

businessName.title: Business name
businessName.description: A registered business name matching the query, exactly as returned by the registry.

businessType.title: Business type
businessType.description: Human-readable entity type label from the registry (e.g. "Sole Proprietor", "Company Limited by Shares", "Company Limited by Guarantee", "Partnership", "External Company", "Subsidiary Business Name").

businessTypeCode.title: Business type code
businessTypeCode.description: The registry's internal short code for businessType (e.g. BN, CS, CG, PN, ET, SN).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for each search result.
